timing_policy: The player posts each presented source frame through the DMA/GPU frame handoff contract and wakes the receiver. Cadence is the saved clip timebase. Records carry source timebase, session, source generation and frame identity. The transport does not own playback time, display refresh or any refresh-rate fallback. The monitor receives posted frames; it does not drain history as a second clock and does not resample to another fps.
gpu_dma_policy: Everything that can remain in DMA/GPU memory must remain there. Local primary backends are windows_dxgi_shared_texture, macos_iosurface and linux_dmabuf. CPU RGBA mmap is disabled for active Broadcast Player preview until a separate fallback is explicitly approved.
